about: The opening in Copperleaf, after the fall: you wake outside Professor Chosen’s lab, he comes running and his assistant Kappi follows him out, you make yourself up, three coins pop open into the starters, you pick one, and the Chosen sends you to the airship mast. Started by New game (cutscene/opening.js); the fall before it is opening-fall.js. RL-8 (the owner's "fall only"): Blake's entrance, the Chosen's fight with him and his battle left the opening; his spots and shots stay for the story.
script: [surprised] Chosen: Whoa. WHOA. You fell out of the sky and you’re alive? That’s a main character move. That’s my move. #l:bfff
Chosen: Stuff comes down through the crust sometimes. Mostly furniture. Furniture has never once been chosen. #l:b29c
Kappi: He means: are you hurt? Take your time. Nothing down here is in a hurry. Except him. #l:2d45
Chosen: Quick, what’s your name? Is it epic? It’s not “The Chosen”, right? That one’s taken. #l:c40b
[surprised] Chosen: Nothing? Not even your name? #l:0beb
[happy] Chosen: Amnesia. Classic origin story. I’d be jealous, but I already have one. #l:0cc5
Kappi: Fall-related amnesia. Very common down here. It comes back slowly. Most good things do. #l:12e4
Chosen: Okay. Sit up. Let’s see what the prophecy has to work with. #l:3720
[happy] Chosen: {name}? Solid sidekick name. Not chosen-tier. But solid. #l:130b
Chosen: I’m Professor Chosen. Nobody gave me the title. It chose me. That’s how chosen works. #l:0e4e
Kappi: I’m Kappi. People add “the Wise”. I do the research. He does the… presence. #l:7fa0
Chosen: These are Billies. Clones of the richest people up top. A lab copied them for fun and filled the gaps with animals. #l:2d9c
Kappi: Then dropped them down here. They went wild. Most of them nap on me now. #l:176f
Chosen: They live in the long grass, in caves and canyons, even in the malls. Walk, and they come to you. Catch them with a pyramid, train a team, earn badges from the arena leaders. #l:5d7e
[happy] Chosen: Every hero needs a companion. Not me, obviously. You. I’ve got three right here. #l:abfa
Chosen: Three Billies, three types. Each one beats one of the others. Choose wisely. Like I would. #l:1ae5
[happy] Chosen: {starter}! Bold. I’d have picked that one too. I didn’t. But I would have. #l:a99c
Chosen: One more thing. See the airship at the mast? It flies out past the island, to wild places nobody’s mapped yet. #l:9e1c
Chosen: Every trip is different. Take {starter}, catch what you can, bring back whatever you find. Side quest. Very important side quest. #l:321e
Kappi: And come back in one piece. Falling once is plenty. There’s a hot bath in the lab. Yuzu in it. #l:30e3
[happy] Chosen: Go whenever you’re ready. The lab’s always open. So is destiny. #l:97b4
